Enter the image of a virtual model (woman). 2. Double-click on the virtual model to load it in. Next, please go to the main menu and select the **2D Version Generator**. Under default settings, the clothing category is set to T-shirt. Currently, the version generator only supports creating T-shirts. The plan is that in the future, we will develop more categories, such as pants and skirts. ## Selecting T-shirt Specifications Here you can choose the T-shirt sleeve type. Currently, the following types can be selected: decoration, insert sleeve, or drop sleeve. Let's choose the decoration type first. Then you will see a list of measurements required for a created version. There is a pull-down menu on the top, in which the standard is selected. A transparent frame version will appear in the window of the 2D version on the right. The frame is automatically loaded with default measurement data. ## Configuring Measurements In the version generator, you can freely configure which measurements to enter to create a version. The pull-down menu will display the data based on the version type selected in the upper layer. This provides two preset options: simple and regular. - **Regular Preset**: Includes more detailed measurement values. It is suitable for when you have all the necessary dimensions, allowing you to enter more measurement values to create a version that is better suited to your desired design. - **Simple Preset**: Provides a set of simplified measurement projects. You only need a few basic values to create a version. This is suitable for first-time version creation or when there is no detailed measurement data. First, click on the one on the right side of the title to show all measurement charts. Each of the measurement projects is grouped together, showing a complete list of measurements that can be used, including the default hidden measurement values. ## Activating and Modifying Measurements You can click on the detailed information icon in the upper right corner to control which measurement projects are in active or stop states. According to the way you activate or stop the measurement, the method of generating versions will also change. - For **Active Projects**: Users directly enter the value and create versions based on these values. - For **Stopped Projects**: Calculate the appropriate value based on actual data, meaning that even if you do not enter all the values, you can still generate accurate versions with the least number of values. For example, in the current simple option, the back piece only activates the full length. Click on the measurement value and adjust the value by moving the mouse wheel. The reset button can reset each measurement item and also reset the entire board, such as the front piece, back piece, and sleeve. Then I will enter again. The total length of the piece is 620. The value related to the width needs to be entered in the corresponding board total width value. Let's enter the total width value as 160 and the total length value as 400. ## Adjusting Sleeve Measurements We will first select the measurement standard as the sleeve to the sleeve and enter the total length value instead of the front piece. Click the total length icon on the right side. In the 2D window, there will be a guideline line with the front piece and the back piece of the chest width. Enter 1000 as the chest width and 960 as the total length of the bottom width. Then enter the measurement value of the sleeve board.
